text:
anna: Uploaded weights for model-x v2 to s3://redwood-models/model-x/v2/weights.pt. Planning canary next Tue in us-west-2. Quick checklist: weights & hashes in place, tokenizer compat, config validation, and catalog metadata pinned. Anyone spot issues?

josh: Where are the sha256sums? I can run the config validator today.

kai: I pulled the model and ran a quick local decode test. Tokenizer quirk: it emits '<unk>' tokens that our registry expects as token_id 0. Suggest adding a small mapping in tokenizer.json or set tokenizer.overrides. Also noticed sentencepiece produces leading-space artifacts on punctuation; consider `trim_offsets: true` on decode.

maria: Checked config.yaml — looks mostly OK but `max_batch_tokens: 4096` will OOM on 8GB instances. Recommend 2048 for canary or use the quantized variant v2-q4 for low-memory hosts. Also add healthcheck config. Example snippet I ran:
```yaml
serving:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  init_prompt: "<|warmup|>"
  healthcheck:
    path: /v1/health
    expect: ok
```

devex: Thx. Please also add a model manifest entry with `supported_regions: ["us-west-2"]` initially. We can enable `eu-west-1` in a second canary after perf looks good.

anna: Done — pushed SHA file at s3://redwood-models/model-x/v2/SHA256SUMS and a small tokenizer patch at s3://redwood-models/model-x/v2/tokenizer_fix.json. Updated config.yaml to `max_batch_tokens: 2048`. Opened manifest PR: https://git.internal/redwood/model-catalog/pull/312 (PTAL).

sre-oncall: For rollout please ensure the healthcheck returns `ok` and the startup path warms the KV cache (use `init_prompt` above). Add alert: `model-x-5xx` if 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m and `model-x-latency` if p50 increases >30% vs baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary started: model-x v2 -> 10% traffic in us-west-2. Rolling window: 15m. Dashboard: https://deploys.internal/redwood/12345 :rocket:

josh: Ran the schema validator: no blocking errors, only warnings about tokenizer vocab mismatch (~40 tokens). I added `tokenizer.overrides = {"<unk>": 0}` in serving config and pushed to the PR branch.

anna: Plan: monitor latency and error budget for 30m, then increase to 50% and kick off eu-west canary if stable. If we hit >2% 5xx or +30% p50 we auto-fallback to v2-q4 (quantized). I'll update the rollout doc and add an explicit `fallback_variant` field in manifest. :thumbsup:

kai: LGTM — I'll run the eval suite against the canary traffic to detect tokenization/regression issues and report back.
